name: llwa-platform
description: LLWA — Learn Language With AI. React Native app, web admin console, and Cloudflare edge backend.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @llwa/shared && npm run build -w @llwa/edge && npm run build -w @llwa/web && npm run build -w @llwa/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.deploy:all: bash scripts/deploy-edge.sh && bash scripts/deploy-frontend-worker.sh && bash scripts/deploy-admin.sh
